name: pi-sandbox
notes: Forked from carderne/pi-sandbox; local fork adds optional pi-tool-display bash rendering decoration with graceful fallback to built-in rendering when pi-tool-display is absent, named sandbox profiles for subagents, the per-session SandboxService profile layer, network.disabled, and protectNonexistentFiles passthrough. v0.6.8 sync adopted upstream's per-session sandbox managers (#84: createSandboxManager per registration instead of the process-wide singleton, manager threaded through initializeSandbox/updateSandboxConfig/createSandboxedBashOps) and hot config updates (#83: updateConfig instead of reset+initialize, preserving in-flight proxy connections); the fork's sandboxManagerFactory seam in src/sandbox-runtime.ts lets tests substitute a stub manager, and fork tests that monkey-patched the old singleton were adapted to the factory. Upstream removed createNetworkAskCallback (stale init-time allowlist could re-allow removed domains); pi-sandbox's interactive promptDomainBlock flow is unaffected. Re-apply the factory seam, tool-display decoration, profile layer, network.disabled, and protectNonexistentFiles on each future sync. 2026-09-19 conflict-surface pass: the write-denial attribution block moved from src/sandbox-runtime.ts to fork-only src/write-denial.ts (the initialize/onCompleted/correlation seams are unchanged); the denyWrite existence check now reuses pathEntryLstatExists exported by the sandbox-runtime fork (root re-export added there) and the duplicate local pathEntryExists was deleted. Fork-appended tests moved out of the upstream test files into fork-only test/profiles-config.test.ts, test/write-denial.test.ts and test/policy-fork.test.ts; test/config.test.ts and test/policy.test.ts are byte-identical to upstream again and test/sandbox-runtime.test.ts keeps only the two @xzzpig package-name lines. 2026-09-19 profile-config decoupling: the fork's profile machinery moved out of src/config.ts into fork-only src/profile-config.ts (PROFILE_* whitelists, validateSandboxProfileName, mergeProfileConfig/validateProfileConfig, configWithoutProfiles, hard-deny validation, mergeProfileLayers, listGlobalSandboxProfiles, SANDBOX_PROFILE_ENV, SandboxConfigLoadOptions, and the options-taking fork loadConfig), leaving src/config.ts at roughly +21/-4 vs upstream: only the fork type fields (network.disabled, SandboxConfigOverride/SandboxProfileConfig, SandboxConfigFile.profiles), the DEFAULT_CONFIG protectNonexistentFiles line, the @xzzpig package imports, and export keywords on mergeObjects/stringArray so the fork layer can reuse them. The fork mergeConfigLayers is a thin wrapper that strips the profiles registry and delegates to the (now exported) upstream mergeConfigLayers; readJsonConfigResult is replicated in profile-config.ts ([fork] comment) because upstream readJsonConfig discards parse errors. The fork loadConfig delegates to the (now exported) upstream loadConfig when no profile is selected and neither config file defines a profiles registry, keeping the no-profile path byte-identical to upstream (silent peek reads decide delegation; the profile path re-reads with warnings). Imports-only rewiring in src/extension.ts, src/service.ts, test/profiles-config.test.ts, test/write-denial.test.ts; test/config.test.ts untouched. Re-apply this module split on each future sync. Sync runbook: after each subtree pull run `git rm packages/pi-sandbox/pnpm-lock.yaml packages/pi-sandbox/pnpm-workspace.yaml` (recurring modify/delete conflict; the package-local workspace files break pnpm pack in the monorepo).
